package virtual_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"math/big"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/ysh0566/ponder-go/abi"
	"github.com/ysh0566/ponder-go/config"
	"github.com/ysh0566/ponder-go/events"
	"github.com/ysh0566/ponder-go/indexing"
)

type specimen struct {
	Event        string
	Item         json.RawMessage
	Wire         events.Object
	Args, Result any
	Receipt      string
}

func decodedBody(t *testing.T, c specimen, receipt bool) indexing.EventView {
	t.Helper()
	chain := events.Object{"name": "mainnet", "id": 1}
	from, to := "0x"+strings.Repeat("12", 20), "0x"+strings.Repeat("34", 20)
	raw := events.RawEvent{Checkpoint: "checkpoint-1", Block: events.Object{"number": big.NewInt(17)}, Transaction: events.Object{"from": from}}
	if receipt {
		raw.TransactionReceipt = events.Object{"status": "success"}
	}
	cb := events.Object{"name": c.Event}
	kind := "block"
	switch {
	case len(c.Item) > 0:
		cb["type"] = "contract"
		cb["abiItem"] = c.Item
		if _, log := c.Wire["topics"]; log {
			kind = "log"
			raw.Log = c.Wire
			raw.Log["logIndex"] = uint64(2)
		} else {
			kind = "trace"
			raw.Trace = c.Wire
			raw.Trace["type"] = "CALL"
		}
	case strings.Contains(c.Event, ":transaction:"):
		cb["type"] = "account"
		kind = "transaction"
	case strings.Contains(c.Event, ":transfer:"):
		cb["type"] = "account"
		kind = "transfer"
		raw.Trace = events.Object{"from": from, "to": to, "value": big.NewInt(19), "type": "CALL"}
	default:
		cb["type"] = "block"
	}
	cb["filter"] = events.Object{"type": kind}
	envelopes, err := new(events.Decoder).DecodeEvents(chain, []events.Object{cb}, []events.RawEvent{raw})
	if err != nil || len(envelopes) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("decode %s: %v, %v", c.Event, envelopes, err)
	}
	return indexing.EventView(envelopes[0]["event"].(events.Object))
}

func checkValue(t *testing.T, got, want any) {
	t.Helper()
	if n, ok := got.(*big.Int); ok {
		got = n.String()
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(got)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var normalized any
	if err = json.Unmarshal(b, &normalized); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if m, ok := normalized.(map[string]any); ok {
		// Go exposes ABI members as exported fields, with the original names retained in tags.
		lower := map[string]any{}
		for key, v := range m {
			lower[strings.ToLower(key[:1])+key[1:]] = v
		}
		normalized = lower
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(normalized, want) {
		t.Fatalf("got %#v, want %#v", normalized, want)
	}
}

func exercise[E any](t *testing.T, raw string, on func(func(context.Context, E, *indexing.Context) error) config.SourceIndexingFunction, check func(E, specimen, bool)) {
	t.Helper()
	var c specimen
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &c); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, has := range []bool{false, true} {
		body := decodedBody(t, c, has)
		chain := &indexing.Context{Chain: indexing.Object{"name": "mainnet", "id": 1}}
		called := false
		reg := on(func(ctx context.Context, e E, got *indexing.Context) error {
			called = true
			if got != chain || ctx != t.Context() {
				t.Fatal("callback context changed")
			}
			check(e, c, has)
			return nil
		})
		if c.Event != reg.Name {
			t.Fatal(reg.Name)
		}
		err := reg.Fn.(indexing.Handler)(t.Context(), &indexing.HandlerArgs{Event: body, Context: chain})
		if c.Receipt == "required" && !has {
			if err == nil || called {
				t.Fatal("missing required receipt accepted")
			}
			continue
		}
		if err != nil || !called {
			t.Fatal(err, called)
		}
	}
}

func checkBlock(t *testing.T, b indexing.EventBlock) {
	t.Helper()
	v, e := b.Number()
	if e != nil || v.Int64() != 17 {
		t.Fatal(v, e)
	}
}
func checkTransaction(t *testing.T, tx indexing.EventTransaction) {
	t.Helper()
	v, e := tx.From()
	if e != nil || v != abi.Hex("0x"+strings.Repeat("12", 20)) {
		t.Fatal(v, e)
	}
}
func checkReceipt(t *testing.T, r indexing.EventReceipt) {
	t.Helper()
	v, e := r.Status()
	if e != nil || v != "success" {
		t.Fatal(v, e)
	}
}
